channel.title: The Mercury News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Mercury News (mercurynews.com)

item.title: Chicago mayor signs executive order calling on police to investigate federal immigration agents accused of misconduct
item.description: Chicago Mayor Brandon Johnson on Saturday signed an executive order directing city police to investigate and document alleged misconduct by federal immigration officers with an eye toward prosecution.

item.title: Trump says feds won’t intervene during protests in Democratic-led cities unless asked to do so
item.description: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he has instructed Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem not to intervene in protests occurring in cities led by Democrats unless local authorities ask for federal help.

item.title: A chatbot entirely powered by humans, not artificial intelligence? This Chilean community shows why
item.description: Cloud computing giants Amazon, Google and Microsoft are among a number of companies that have built or planned data centers in the Santiago region.

item.title: New US charge d’affaires arrives in Venezuela to reopen diplomatic mission after 7 years
item.description: U.S. charge d’affaires Laura Dogu arrived in Caracas on Saturday to reopen the American diplomatic mission in Venezuela after seven years of severed ties.

item.title: Sharks finish Canadian road swing with loss to Calgary as Joel Farabee’s shorthanded goal makes the difference late
item.description: NHL: The San Jose Sharks suffered their second straight loss in Canada to end a Canadian road swing, conceding two early leads

item.title: Camden scores 26 points, Dut an unlikely hero in Cal’s 86-85 win over Miami
item.description: Little-used Dut had a critical block late and followed that with his only basket of the game to send Cal to a victory in Miami.

item.title: House fire in Pleasanton displaces woman and dog, chief says
item.description: A woman and dog safely escaped a house fire Friday night in Pleasanton, according to the Livermore-Pleasanton Fire chief.

item.title: Steph Curry injury update: Warriors provide new info on sore knee
item.description: Steph Curry left Friday's game against the Pistons in the third quarter, did not return.

item.title: SF Giants agree with three-time batting champ Luis Arraez on one-year deal: report
item.description: Arraez will probably slot in as the starting second baseman, which would turn infielder Casey Schmitt into a super utility player.

item.title: Sharks squander golden chance to bolster playoff position as another Canadian team makes a comeback
item.description: NHL: The San Jose Sharks suffered their second straight loss to end a three-game Canadian road swing, conceding two early leads and hurting their chances to make the playoffs.
